interpretation: Rounded regional epidermis/dermis reference values. Not measurements of an individual. All subcutaneous values and unsampled sites are authored visualization estimates.

abdomen.label: 腹臀部
abdomen.basis: study abdomen mean; gluteal assignment authored

upperArm.label: 上臂
upperArm.basis: average of study flexor/extensor means, rounded

forearm.label: 前臂
forearm.basis: average of study flexor/extensor means, rounded

thigh.label: 大腿
thigh.basis: average of study flexor/outer means, rounded

lowerLeg.label: 小腿
lowerLeg.basis: average of study medial/lateral means, rounded

palm.label: 掌侧
palm.basis: authored thick-skin site; not study data

sole.label: 足底
sole.basis: authored thick-skin site; not study data

limitations: Regional mapping is approximate, not histological segmentation.
Subcutaneous thickness is an authored estimate, not measured fat volume.
Inset shells are visual boundaries, not closed volumetric tissue meshes.
No skin constitutive law or clinical calibration is claimed.
